mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0% (the 25th percentile of historical levels).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points in a month signals economic weakness that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) both increase by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals robust economic growth that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both rise > 0.5% MoM
evidence_refs: doc:Consumer Spending and Housing Market Correlation
failure_condition: The joint signal (both RSAFS and HOUST rising >0.5% MoM) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime, a rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.2% month-over-month signals inflationary pressures that lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in a Fed tightening.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises >0.2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (the 2017 base) signals economic contraction that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it signals robust consumer demand and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST is above the 75th percentile of historical levels.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL rising >0.2% MoM) signals aggressive policy tightening that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2% MoM
evidence_refs: doc:Monetary Policy Tightening and Equity Markets
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises >0.1pp and CPIAUCSL rises >0.2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE < 3.5%.
